cli.teams_help.create_name: Name of the team to create
cli.teams_help.create_manager: Role or specialist who orchestrates (default: manager)
cli.teams_help.create_member: Roster slot as role or role:count (repeatable)
cli.teams_help.create_label: Display label shown in listings, the chart and the status band (free text; addressing still uses the name)
cli.teams_help.create_alias: Extra addressing key for this team (repeatable; letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen)
cli.teams_help.show: Show a team's roster and briefs
cli.teams_help.show_name: Name of the team to show
cli.teams_help.delete_name: Name of the team to delete
cli.teams_help.push: Push a team to an organization or the public hub (Agent Hub); exit codes: 0 published, 1 error, 2 preview-only with changes pending, 3 declined, 130 cancelled
cli.teams_help.push_name: Name of the local team to push
cli.teams_help.push_org: Organization tenant to publish into (`lop teams push --org <tenant_id> <team>`; requires `lop login radient`)
cli.teams_help.push_public: Publish to the public Agent Hub instead of an organization
cli.teams_help.push_id: Hub team id to overwrite (republish; what `lop teams push` printed as "Team ID"); needs --org or --public
cli.teams_help.pull: Pull a team from the hub by id, or by name from the public hub (Agent Hub)
cli.teams_help.pull_team_id: ID of the published team to pull, or a public team's name (`lop teams pull a-team`; names resolve over the public listing)
cli.teams_help.pull_org: Organization tenant the team belongs to (`lop teams pull --org <tenant_id> <team-id>`; requires `lop login radient`)
cli.teams_help.sync: Check pulled teams against the hub and merge their updates
cli.teams_help.sync_name: Sync only the team with this name
cli.teams_help.sync_all: Sync every linked team (default when --name is absent)
cli.teams_help.link: Link a local team to a hub team so it can receive updates
cli.teams_help.link_hub_team_id: ID of the hub team to link it to
cli.teams_help.link_org: Organization tenant that owns the hub team
cli.teams_help.link_accept_unknown_basel: Link even though the local copy differs from the hub's (nothing is deleted)
cli.teams_help.search: Search the public Agent Hub for teams
cli.teams_help.search_query: Text to match against a public team's name or description (omit to list the newest teams)
cli.teams_help.search_page: Page to list when no query is given (default: 1)
cli.teams_help.search_perpage: Teams per page for a listing (default: 20; the hub maxes at 100)
cli.teams_help.search_json: Print the raw listing or matches as JSON
